arguments.content: Amateur astronomy involves joining local clubs for night sky viewing and requires purchasing a telescope and mount with an estimated start-up cost of $2,000 to $5,000. Nature photography groups organize outdoor excursions to capture landscapes and non-bird wildlife needing a dedicated camera and lens setup costing approximately $1,000 to $3,000. Recreational kayaking allows for social paddling events on lakes or rivers and requires a kayak and safety gear estimated between $600 and $2,000. Community gardening provides opportunities to work alongside neighbors on shared outdoor plots requiring tools and seed fees totaling around $150 to $300. Group hiking clubs lead organized trail walks and require sturdy footwear and a backpack with start-up expenses of $100 to $200.
